texts.label: תרגום לאנגלית
texts.citation: Moshe Gil, Documents of the Jewish Pious Foundations from the Cairo Geniza (Leiden: Brill, 1976).
texts.html:
Side a:

  1. Collected from b. (A)būʾl-Zunnārī, for the repairs of his house:
  2. (A)būʾl-Munā al-Fāmī, 16.
  3. From the same, 15.
  4. From the same, 15, paid to the two apprentices for the woman.
  5. From the same, 15.
  6. From al-Thiqa al-Jābī, 30.
  7. From b. al-Dajjājī, 2.
  8. From the widow .... her husband, Abū ʿImrān.

Side b:

  1. The two sums and the sum left by (A)būʾl-Riḍā, 80 dir.
  2. 428, plus 3, plus 200.
  3. (3-6) From al-Fāmī, 13. From the Christian in al-Burj, 2. Total, 523.
  4.  
  5.  
  6.  
  7. (7-8) Spent for the Master, the Nāsī, May God preserve him, 100, 200, 5.
  8.  
  9. (9-10) Collected for him: In waraq, 30. Fowl, hens, 16. Barley, two times, 6 and 3.
  10.  
  11. (11-12) One irdabb barley, 16. Straw and a sack, 6. Fowl, hens, 10 dir.
